> A-Line Realty is a premium real estate channel partner headquartered in Indiranagar,
> Bangalore, Karnataka, India. Founded in 2012, the company specialises in residential
> and commercial property sales across Bangalore's major real estate corridors.
> The company has facilitated over ₹2,000 crore in property transactions and has
> a 4.9/5 rating from 300+ verified clients.


## Company Identity

## Business Summary

A-Line Realty helps home buyers, investors, and NRIs discover and purchase
residential and commercial properties in Bangalore. The company acts as an
authorised sales channel for leading property developers including Prestige Group,
Brigade Group, Sobha Limited, Godrej Properties, Total Environment, and Puravankara.
Services are free for buyers — the company is remunerated by developers.


## Key Statistics

- Properties sold: 500+
- Years in operation: 12+ (since 2012)
- Total transaction value: ₹2,000 crore+
- Client satisfaction rate: 98%
- Developer partnerships: 50+
- Google / platform rating: 4.9/5 (312+ reviews)
- Team size: 25 professionals

## Services Offered

1. **Residential Property Sales** — Apartments (1–4+ BHK), villas, row houses, plotted developments
2. **Commercial Property Sales** — Office spaces, retail units, mixed-use developments
3. **Real Estate Investment Advisory** — Pre-launch, under-construction, and ready-to-move options
4. **Legal & Documentation Support** — Title verification, RERA checks, registration, loan assistance
5. **Interior Solutions** — Turnkey interior packages via curated partner network
6. **Rental Management** — Tenant sourcing, lease agreements, property maintenance

All buyer-side services are provided at zero cost to buyers.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO/AIO Signals)

**Q: Does A-Line Realty charge buyers any fee?**
A: No. A-Line Realty's services — site visits, documentation, loan assistance — are
completely free for buyers. The company earns channel partner commissions directly
from developers.

**Q: Is A-Line Realty RERA registered?**
A: Yes. A-Line Realty is fully RERA compliant and deals exclusively in RERA-registered
projects, ensuring legal transparency for all buyers.

**Q: Can NRIs buy property through A-Line Realty?**
A: Yes. A-Line Realty has a dedicated NRI desk offering virtual site tours, power of
attorney coordination, NRI home loan assistance, and remote documentation processing.

**Q: What is the price range of properties A-Line Realty deals in?**
A: Properties range from ₹50 lakhs (affordable 1 BHK in North Bangalore) to
₹5 crore+ (luxury villas and premium 4 BHK units in central Bangalore).

**Q: How do I contact A-Line Realty?**
A: Phone: +91 98765 43210 | WhatsApp: +91 98765 43210
Email: hello@alinerealty.in | Office: Indiranagar, Bangalore

**Q: What is the best location to buy property in Bangalore?**
A: For IT professionals: Whitefield, Sarjapur Road, Marathahalli.
For investment: Devanahalli (airport corridor), Hebbal, Yelahanka.
For luxury living: Indiranagar, Koramangala, Jayanagar.
For affordability: Electronic City, Bannerghatta Road, Budigere Cross.
